maddeler.e:
أنتصف (form VIII)
# أَنْتَصِفُ (ʔantaṣifu) /ʔan.ta.sˤi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
# أَنْتَصِفَ (ʔantaṣifa) /ʔan.ta.sˤi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
# أَنْتَصِفْ (ʔantaṣif) /ʔan.ta.sˤif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَصَفَ (intaṣafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
